prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: transparent standalone logo mark for Palladium, a native macOS notes app.
Primary request: create one original, impeccably simple sculpted palladium-metal symbol. Apple and Obsidian are references only for simplicity and instantly readable silhouette; do not reproduce either logo.
Subject: a single compact asymmetric solid, gently upright, like a softly folded silver pebble. Its outer contour is smooth and rounded; one deliberate inward curve along the upper-right edge creates a recognizable silhouette. No separate parts, no letter, no hole, no sharp crystalline facets.
Style/medium: premium polished metal 3D logo render with a clean graphic silhouette.
Materials/textures: polished palladium silver, realistic controlled chrome reflections, broad luminous highlights, charcoal reflections defining the contours. Smooth flawless surface without scratches, brushed grain or iridescence.
Composition/framing: square 1024 x 1024 composition, symbol centered, about 72 percent of canvas height, balanced generous empty margin. Frontal three-quarter view with minimal perspective.
Lighting/mood: neutral studio lighting, bright silver body and deliberate darker edging so the shape stays legible at 16 to 128 pixels.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background. No ground plane, no cast shadow outside the symbol.
Constraints: exactly one symbol, no text, no wordmark, no tile, no frame, no watermark, no colored reflections. Elegant restrained shape rather than a complex blob. Preserve real transparency.
icon: PalladiumAppIcon.png uses the unchanged generated mark on an AppKit pearl-white rounded-square tile; see scripts/compose-branding.swift.
wordmark: PalladiumWordmark.png uses NSFont.systemFont(ofSize: 100, weight: .medium); SVG uses the system sans-serif font stack.
